Peer Assessment Rubric

  • TEI Choice Markup Validity (4 pts): The <choice> elements correctly enclose paired <orig>/<reg> or <abbr>/<expan> children without syntax errors, broken tags, or omitted milestone elements (<lb/>).
  • Deterministic Rule Precision (3 pts): The regular expressions (in VS Code Find & Replace or script) use appropriate word boundaries (\b) and capture groups to avoid corrupting substrings, entity references, or XML markup.
  • Comparative Critical Analysis (3 pts): The reflection articulates a clear philological rationale distinguishing legitimate dialectal variants from mechanical spelling slips, diagnosing specific instances of AI hypercorrection, and evaluating the precision-recall trade-off.
